description.from: List sessions across agents sorted by last activity, open a session by id, walk its messages in order. Specs first: features/01_session_history/*.feature; implementation generated from the specs.
description.to: Chapter 1 of the BotSpy docs: the basic structure of records — the session object, ordered messages, and walking through them — including the message/part anatomy (text, thinking, tool calls and results, attachments, provenance), the extra escape hatch, and the twelve pending schema extensions. Absorbs the old Layer 1 (unified session history) and Layer 2 (normalized schema) epics: their tasks live under this epic now.
